Directions: Based on the passage below and on your knowledge of social studies, answer each question that follows.
Content: For a fortnight Gandhi's march is intended to be only a demonstration. Then, when he expects to be at the sea, he will begin to produce salt from brine [salt water], and so infringe [violate] the Government salt monopoly, defying the Government to arrest and punish him. At the same time his supporters everywhere have been incited by him to refuse to pay local taxes.
Copyright: — Gandhi's March to the Sea, The Guardian, `1930`
